thread:
Noah (Partnerships): AetherGrid just dropped final assets for the marketplace tile + co-branded solution brief. Need a quick QA pass on logo lockup, alt text, and the one-line marketplace blurb. Links below. Can we aim to ship to marketplace by tomorrow morning?

Raj (Design): Figma looks fine at first glance. Flag: their wordmark has very thin strokes — it collapses at 64px. Requesting a solid-fill SVG or a thicker outline variant. Also will check clearspace for the tile.

Amy (Partner Marketing): They also sent two quote options. I prefer the shorter one for the marketplace tile — more scannable. Quote A: "Redwood + AetherGrid cut inference cost by 4x for high-throughput apps." Quote B (short): "4x lower inference cost with Redwood + AetherGrid." Thoughts?

Liz (Legal): Brand guidelines OK with our co-badging layout (partner badge left, Redwood lockup right). Need a partner-signed approval email saved in the deal folder before we publish. Also: alt text must not include trademark marks or legalese.

Raj (Design): Quick micro checklist I'll run:
- export SVG named `aethergrid_logo_fill.svg` and `aethergrid_logo_on_dark.svg`
- PNG at 1x/2x for marketplace tile `tile@1x.png`, `tile@2x.png`
- 1200x628 PDF for solution brief hero
I'll post exports here when done.

DesignBot: Automated asset QA: logo contrast ✓, SVG viewbox OK ✓, raster fallback present ✓, clearspace check FAIL (needs +8px on left). Alt text length limit 140 chars.

Noah (Partnerships): Amy can you pick Quote B for the tile? Jordan, any content constraints from the marketplace listing side (character limits, CTA phrasing)?

Jordan (PM): Marketplace title limit is 60 chars, short description 200 chars, the tile blurb should be <= 90 chars to avoid truncation on mobile. CTA must be either `Contact sales` or `Get started` per marketplace rules. Recommend `Contact sales` for co-sell.

Amy (Partner Marketing): Agree on Quote B and `Contact sales`. I'll draft the short description: "Redwood Inference + AetherGrid: optimized, low-latency LLM inference for scale. Contact sales for pricing." Will paste in the assets folder.

Liz (Legal): Once Noah attaches the partner-signed approval, we can proceed. Also keep the partner's trademark descriptor consistent: use `AetherGrid` (no ®).

Raj (Design): Uploaded exports: `2030001234-aethergrid-tile@2x.png`, `aethergrid_logo_fill.svg` in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link. Adjusted clearspace to +8px — re-exported.

Noah (Partnerships): Perfect. Amy, can you confirm the marketplace copy in the shared doc and @AetherGrid for final sign-off? I'll queue the publish request once legal confirms. :thumbsup:

Amy (Partner Marketing): On it — pinging AetherGrid contact now.

DesignBot: Reminder: attach `alt_text.txt` with approved alt: `Redwood Inference and AetherGrid solution for low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference.`

Noah (Partnerships): Thanks team — will update thread when partner approval lands.

Amy (Partner Marketing): Partner replied with approval email + timestamp, forwarding to @Liz.

Liz (Legal): Got it — legal signs off. Noah, you can proceed to request marketplace publish.

Noah (Partnerships): Filing ticket with marketplace team now: https://internal.tools/issues/INV-4521. ETA publish request submitted. Closing this QA thread — follow-up in the publish ticket. :white_check_mark:
